name: adp_basic_with_ccId
spec_quote: key = "adp:" + cid lower-cased + ":" + jobId lower-cased. api_url = "https://" + host lower-cased + "/mascsr/default/careercenter/public/events/staffing/v1/job-requisitions/" + jobId + "?cid=" + cid + "&lang=en_US", and, only when the link has a non-empty ccId, "&ccId=" + ccId appended.

name: adp_case_insensitive_params_shared_cloud_host
spec_quote: The query parameters cid and jobId are read case-insensitively (cid / CID, jobId / jobid / JOBID; ccId / ccid too). Values keep their original case and are URL-quoted (plain letters, digits, "-", "_" stay as they are).

name: adp_missing_jobId_is_null
spec_quote: When cid or jobId is missing or empty → null (such a link is a job list, not one posting).

name: adp_empty_cid_is_null
spec_quote: When cid or jobId is missing or empty → null (such a link is a job list, not one posting).

name: adp_wrong_path_is_null
spec_quote: Only links to an ADP Workforce Now career center: host workforcenow.adp.com or workforcenow.cloud.adp.com, path /mascsr/default/mdf/recruitment/recruitment.html, followed by a query string. Anything else → null.

name: adp_ccId_url_quoted
spec_quote: only when the link has a non-empty ccId, "&ccId=" + ccId appended. Values keep their original case and are URL-quoted (plain letters, digits, "-", "_" stay as they are).

name: gh_simple_order_and_lowercase

name: gh_duplicates_are_removed_after_lowercase
spec_quote: list of Greenhouse board names the page names, lower-cased, in order of first appearance, each once.

name: gh_reserved_words_are_not_boards
spec_quote: The words embed, v1, jobs, job_app, job_board are never boards.

name: gh_empty_page
spec_quote: Empty / None page → [].

name: gh_embed_js_and_eu_job_boards
spec_quote: A board name is the word ([A-Za-z0-9_-]+) right after any of: ... "boards.greenhouse.io/embed/job_board/js?for=", ... "job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io/", ...

name: gh_boards_api_eu_and_boards_eu

name: job_url_myworkdaysite_no_locale
spec_quote: host ending in "myworkdaysite.com" (shared host, e.g. wd3.myworkdaysite.com): "https://" + host + "/recruiting/" + tenant + "/" + site + path  (no locale).

name: job_url_myworkdayjobs_en_us
spec_quote: any other host (e.g. acme.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com): "https://" + host + "/en-US/" + site + path.

name: job_url_myworkdaysite_adds_missing_leading_slash
spec_quote: path is the posting path "/job/<location>/<slug>_<id>" (a missing leading "/" is added).

name: job_url_myworkdayjobs_adds_missing_leading_slash
spec_quote: path is the posting path "/job/<location>/<slug>_<id>" (a missing leading "/" is added). any other host (e.g. acme.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com): "https://" + host + "/en-US/" + site + path.

name: job_url_exact_myworkdaysite_host_uses_shared_form
spec_quote: host ending in "myworkdaysite.com" (shared host, e.g. wd3.myworkdaysite.com): "https://" + host + "/recruiting/" + tenant + "/" + site + path  (no locale).

name: job_url_host_not_ending_myworkdaysite_is_other

name: parse_tenant_myworkdaysite_with_locale_example
spec_quote: on wdN.myworkdaysite.com it accepts an optional locale segment such as "en-US" before "recruiting": https://wd5.myworkdaysite.com/en-US/recruiting/sevtalcor/Sevtalcor_External_/job/x → ["wd5.myworkdaysite.com", "sevtalcor", "Sevtalcor_External_"].

name: parse_tenant_myworkdaysite_without_locale

name: parse_tenant_myworkdaysite_without_recruiting_is_null
spec_quote: A myworkdaysite link without "recruiting/<tenant>/" → null.

name: parse_tenant_myworkdayjobs_with_locale
spec_quote: myworkdayjobs links: host lower-cased, tenant = first host label, site = first path segment after an optional locale; first segment "wday" or "job" → null.

name: parse_tenant_myworkdayjobs_without_locale_lowercases_host
spec_quote: myworkdayjobs links: host lower-cased, tenant = first host label, site = first path segment after an optional locale.

name: parse_tenant_myworkdayjobs_wday_first_segment_is_null

name: page_verdict_closed_notice_example

args.title: Job
args.text:
Search Jobs
You can't view this job because it's not available at this time.
About Seagate

spec_quote: Closed notice: the page text (first 2500 characters) contains "can't view this job because" / "cannot view this job because" (also position / posting / requisition), and the page has little job text ... → status "closed".

name: page_verdict_closed_notice_position_variant

args.title: Job
args.text: Cannot view this position because it is no longer open.

spec_quote: Closed notice: the page text (first 2500 characters) contains "can't view this job because" / "cannot view this job because" (also position / posting / requisition) ... → status "closed".

name: page_verdict_closed_notice_wins_over_site_error

args.title: Job
args.text:
You can't view this job because it's not available.
Something went wrong. Please try again later.

spec_quote: This test comes after the security-check test ... after the closed tests ... a closed notice wins over a site error ... before the sign-in test.

name: page_verdict_site_error_beats_sign_in

args.title: Job
args.text:
Sign in
Something went wrong. Please try again later.

spec_quote: Site error: a short page (under 1500 characters) whose first 2500 characters say the site itself failed — ... "something went wrong" ... → status "unreadable" (not "login"), even when a line "Sign in" is at the top of the page.

name: page_verdict_short_sign_in_without_site_error_is_login

args.title: Sign in
args.text:
Sign in
Welcome back. Please enter your credentials.

spec_quote: Unchanged: a short page whose first line is "Sign in" and that has no site-error words → "login".

name: page_verdict_plenty_job_text_is_ok

text_repeat.chunk: Responsibilities: build reliable systems. Qualifications: experience with testing and degree. Skills: communication.

spec_quote: Unchanged: ... a page with plenty of job text (over 600 characters and at least 2 job words) and no closed notice → "ok".
